_data: psmatch2_llr_data.csv (set seed 4242, n=200); the _weight/_y columns in that CSV come from the llr + tricube run
_note: psmatch2 reports seatt = . (missing) for genuine local linear regression matching, so only the point estimate can be pinned. With kerneltype(epan) -- the DEFAULT for llr -- psmatch2 does NOT run LLR at all: it rewrites the request as nearest-neighbour matching on an lpoly-smoothed outcome and reports a non-missing SE. That reroute is recorded here so the divergence is documented rather than discovered.

llr_epan_reroute._stata_command: psmatch2 d x1 x2, outcome(y) llr kerneltype(epan) bwidth(0.5) logit
llr_epan_reroute._behaviour: psmatch2.ado rewrites method to 'neighbor' and smooths the outcome with lpoly, deg(1); it is NOT local linear regression matching

kernel_tricube._stata_command: psmatch2 d x1 x2, outcome(y) kernel kerneltype(tricube) bwidth(0.5) logit

mahalanobis._stata_command: psmatch2 d, outcome(y) mahalanobis(x1 x2) neighbor(1)
